items.category: Software Component Verification and Integration Verification
items.name: Eclipse Dash License Tool
items.subcategory: Software Composition Analysis Scanners and Analyzers
items.description: The Eclipse Dash License Tool identifies the licenses of the content of a project's dependencies. It takes a list of dependencies as input, resolves each against the Eclipse Foundation's ClearlyDefined and IP Team databases, and reports the license information along with whether the content is approved for use.

items.description: cdxgen is a CLI tool, library, and server for generating CycloneDX Bill of Materials (SBOM, CBOM, OBOM, SaaSBOM, CDXA) for most languages, package managers, and container images.
